resources.string: Transfers playlists, favourites, queue, ratings, notes, tags, BPM, credits, lyrics, artwork and settings on the same device. Audio files are excluded. Keep the original music folder and grant access again during import. A file mismatch leaves existing data unchanged.
Transfer could not be completed. Existing data has not been replaced.

Music data exported. Open Music in toolbox pre-3.0.0-3, then open Settings → Music data transfer → Import music data. Select this file and grant access to the original music folder. Keep the old app until data and playback have been checked.
Select the music storage folder used by the old app. Files are verified and linked without copying or modifying audio.
Import replaces the current internal music data and settings. Original audio files and the old app’s data are not changed.
Music data imported. Check playlists, lyrics and artwork and test playback before uninstalling the old music app.
